title: 2008 AMC 12A Problem 10
statement: Doug can paint a room in \(5\) hours. Dave can paint the same room in \(7\) hours. Doug and Dave paint the room together and take a one-hour break for lunch. Let \(t\) be the total time, in hours, required for them to complete the job working together, including lunch. Which of the following equations is satisfied by \(t?\)

solutions.text:
In one hour Doug paints \(\tfrac{1}{5}\) of the room and Dave paints \(\tfrac{1}{7},\) so together they paint \(\tfrac{1}{5} + \tfrac{1}{7}\) of the room per hour.

Of the total time \(t,\) one hour is spent at lunch, so they work for \(t - 1\) hours. The fraction painted must equal \(1,\) giving \[ \left(\dfrac{1}{5} + \dfrac{1}{7}\right)(t - 1) = 1. \]

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Together they paint \(\dfrac{1}{5} + \dfrac{1}{7}\) of the room each hour
Of the \(t\) hours, one hour is lunch, so they actually work \(t - 1\) hours
